---
name: Emulator behavior
about: Report a reproducible CPU, device, boot, or frontend problem
---

## Input and environment

Model/revision, source commit, compiler/browser, native or WASM. For ROM-based
reports, provide the input size/hash and provenance; do not attach firmware.

## Reproduction

Exact command or UI sequence, budget, initial state and expected behavior.

## Observed evidence

Stop PC/opcode/address, bounded trace or minimal original instruction case.
Separate payload execution, control return and visible interactive UI.

## Reference

Manual section or independent hardware observation. No copied emulator code.
